adaptations: React hook state becomes a synchronous Rust controller; an owned Instant deadline replaces setTimeout while preserving the one-shot 120 ms notice window and drop cancellation.
Hunk config paths and branding become Workdeck paths and labels; HOME shortening retains Hunk's explicit string-prefix behavior.
The Ratatui shell owns modal geometry, keyboard swallowing, mouse hit maps, and footer notices while the controller owns the mounted baseline and action lock.
Flat Hunk-compatible persisted keys are projected into Workdeck's canonical nested runtime schema during config loading, so a successful save takes effect on the next launch.
The standalone and unified Workdeck loops both poll the owned deadline and exit without requiring an additional input event.
